author: PublixEmployee
body:
This is mostly a problem for users and not mods, but when making a in-game report it gets annoying when you see multiple people breaking a rule, such as swearing or disrespect towards other users, and you have to wait 30 seconds between every report. It gets tough for the player to make all the reports in time.

It would make it easier for the time between reports you can make was 10 seconds.

Why 10 seconds?

Because that is what I find the "sweet spot." Most people would take a bit of time to type out the next report. That wouldn't be too long for the player to make the report, but other users wouldn't be able to spam it.
